sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2002 Chevrolet Corvette Z06, finished in black with a black interior. This Corvette is equipped with a 6-speed manual transmission, and the odometer currently displays approximately 13,400 miles. The attached Carfax history report lists no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this Corvette's past. Factory equipment includes a limited-slip differential, an active handling system, pop-up headlights, leather upholstery, a head-up display, a Bose audio system, and more as detailed below. Modifications reported by the seller are limited to 18- and 19-inch C6 Corvette ZR1-style wheels, tinted windows, and a chrome trim plate between the exhaust pipes. To build the high-performance C5-generation Z06, Chevy started with the rigid fixed-roof coupe body style and focused on weight reduction, with a titanium exhaust, thinner glass panels, lightweight wheels and battery, and reduced soundproofing. The LS6 V8 adds 55 horsepower over the standard coupe, and an upgraded FE4 suspension completes the Z06's track-focused transformation. Power comes from an LS6 5.7-liter V8 engine, rated at 405 horsepower and 400 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 6-speed manual transmission.
